in_sanskrit.name: सिद्दान्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is established, settled, firm, unchangeable. Derived from the root 'sidh' meaning to establish or accomplish and the suffix 'ant' meaning one who.

in_hindi.name: सिद्दान्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: सिद्ध (siddh) means accomplished or established. The suffix '-ant' means one who. So, Siddant can be translated as the one who is established or accomplished.

in_tamil.name: சித்தந்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Siddant is derived from the Tamil word 'citttam', which means established or settled. It can be translated as the one who is established or settled.

in_telugu.name: సిద్దంట
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Siddant is derived from the Telugu word 'siddham', which means established or settled. It can be translated as the one who is established or settled.

in_marathi.name: Siddant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Siddant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Siddh means 'achieved' and Ant means 'direction'. Siddant is a name of the Lord Vishnu and represents the one who has achieved and is moving in the direction of knowledge and prosperity.

in_bengali.name: Siddant
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Achiever, Knowledgeable
in_bengali.long_meaning: Siddant একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Siddh means 'achieved' and Ant means 'direction'. Siddant is a name of the Lord Vishnu and represents the one who has achieved and is moving in the direction of knowledge and prosperity.
